test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

The ______ cannot be a panacea for all respiratory infections.
solution: The correct answer is '**treatment**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**treatment**'. • It means 'the use of medicine or medical care to cure an illness or injury; something that is done to make somebody feel and look good'. [किसी बीमार या घायल व्‍यक्ति का इलाज (औषध या परिचर्या द्वारा)] • *Example: to require hospital/medical **treatment**...* • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **healing**: to become healthy again; to make something healthy again. (पुनः स्‍वस्‍थ हो जाना; पुनः स्‍वस्‍थ कर देना) • **care**: looking after somebody/something so that he/she/it has what he/she/it needs for his/her/its health and protection. (किसी की देखभाल या देखरेख) • **diagnosis**: the act of saying exactly what illness a person has or what the cause of a problem is. (रोगी के रोग और समस्‍या के कारण को पहचानने की क्रिया; निदान-क्रिया) • As per the above definitions, we find that the correct answer is** Option 4.** **Correct Sentence:__** *The **treatment** cannot be a panacea for all respiratory infections.* 42:Tfd1, The correct answer is **'internal'.**
